seo.title: Cycle Easy — Private Period Tracker for iOS
seo.description: Your cycle data belongs to you. Cycle Easy is a privacy-first period tracker that keeps everything local. No accounts, no cloud, no tracking. Ever.

hero.label: PERIOD TRACKING
hero.title: Your cycle, your privacy.
text: A period tracker that keeps everything on your device. No accounts. No cloud. No data collection. Your most intimate health data stays exactly where it belongs — with you.

screenshots.alt: Cycle Easy — Your Cycle, Your Privacy
screenshots.label: Your Cycle, Your Privacy

sections.label: OUR COMMITMENT
sections.title: Your data never leaves your device. Period.
intro: In today's world, your health data has never been more sensitive. We built Cycle Easy with one principle: your cycle data belongs to you and only you. There are no servers, no databases, no way for anyone — including us — to access your information.

items.title: 100% Local
items.text: All data stored on device only

sections.label: FEATURES
sections.title: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.

items.title: Period Tracking
items.text: Log your period start and end dates with a single tap. Track flow intensity and see your complete cycle history at a glance.

items.title: Smart Predictions
items.text: Your next period, predicted based on your own data. The app learns your unique cycle patterns and improves accuracy over time.

items.title: Symptom Logging
items.text: Track cramps, mood, energy, headaches, and more. Quick daily logging helps you spot patterns and understand your body better.

items.title: Cycle Calendar
items.text: Beautiful calendar views show your cycle at a glance. See patterns across months with the year-at-a-glance view.

items.title: Privacy-Safe Widget
items.text: Current cycle day at a glance on your home screen. Shows only "Day X" — no sensitive details visible to others.

items.title: Your Data, Your Control
items.text: Export all your data as JSON anytime. Delete everything with a single tap. Complete control over your information.

sections.label: HEALTHKIT
sections.title: Optional. Off by default.
text: Cycle Easy can sync with Apple Health — but only if you explicitly enable it. HealthKit integration is disabled by default. If you choose to enable it, data flows only to Apple Health on your device, governed by Apple's strict privacy protections. We never see it.

cta.title: Privacy-first period tracking.
cta.text: Coming soon to the App Store. No account required.
